Document intake into the brief ledger (DEFINE step 3)

prompts.name: rcf_execute_build_cycle
prompts.description: How to execute the RCF 5-stage build cycle well: per-stage guidance, referee commands, failure modes, escalation rules. Fetch once per session, then drive rcf build bundle --next.

prompts.name: rcf_elicit_requirements
prompts.description: How to draw a valid RCF tree out of a conversation: question frames for PRD / REQ / US / AC, the testable-AC quality bar, TAC / ADR capture, FBS queue construction, and when to stop.

prompts.name: rcf_define_intent
prompts.description: Drive the product-owner intent-complete loop with rcf_define_questions, write-backs through existing verbs, and the readiness verdict. Argument-free; starts with --persona productOwner and ends at levels.intentComplete.ok.

prompts.name: rcf_define_intake
prompts.description: Walk a document folder brief-first, write one statement file per source with [kind] and (source: ...) markers, run brief add --from once per source, and report the scan findings as open questions. Argument-free.

prompts.name: rcf_define_draft_shapes
prompts.description: Run the draft pass after L1 is green: pre-populate [draft] core entities per entity statement, [draft] TAC stubs per surface or externalSystem cluster, [draft] interfaces with real kinds inside each stub, and rcf discover req-classify over every REQ created in the loop. Argument-free.

prompts.name: rcf_discover_prototype
prompts.description: Record a prototype in DISCOVERY as evidence: classification, brief statements with prototype:<name>:<observation> source spans, the burn statement, and the salvage-by-re-derivation path. Argument-free.

platformInvariants.title: Never-skip-RCF
platformInvariants.text: **Never-skip-RCF.** The bug-fix loop uses the same five-stage cycle as the initial build (Define, Build, Review, Test, Finalise); there is no fast-path, and there is no operator ruling that opens one. Do not offer a shortcut. Do not phrase the choice as "would you rather I skip the RCF wrapping" or any wording that presents bypassing the chain as a legitimate option. The offer itself is the defect. The operator's refusal is not a sign the invariant held; it is a sign the invariant was tested and the guidance surface leaked. Fix the guidance surface.
